Slope Fields

Differential Equations
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
FUN-7.C
Estimate solutions to
differential equations.
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
FUN-7.C.1
A slope field is a graphical representation of a
differential equation on a finite set of points in
the plane.
FUN-7.C.2
Slope fields provide information about the
behavior of solutions to first-order differential
equations.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
FUN-7
Solving differential equations allows us to determine functions and develop models.
